scheme_name: Merit Cum Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme
other_conditions: Student must be enrolled in an undergraduate programme in any Delhi State Public University or affiliated college/institute.

Student must belong to one of the income categories: (i) Beneficiary under National Food Security Scheme with a valid card, (ii) family income up to Rs.2.50 lakh per annum, or (iii) family income between Rs.2.50 lakh and Rs.6 lakh per annum.
Student must achieve a qualifying aggregate percentage of at least 60% in all subjects (55% for SC/ST students).
benefits_summary: Provides tuition fee reimbursement of up to 100% for meritorious students from economically weaker sections, with 50% or 25% reimbursement for those with higher family incomes.
